name: Trip Summary Report
query:
SELECT
    t.name AS "Trip:Link/Trip:150",
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:150",
    d.name AS "Driver:Link/Driver:150",
    t.status AS "Status:120",
    t.start_date AS "Start Date:Date:120",
    t.end_date AS "End Date:Date:120",
    t.distance_km AS "Distance:Float:100"
FROM `tabTrip` t
LEFT JOIN `tabVehicle` v
    ON t.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN `tabDriver` d
    ON t.driver = d.name
WHERE
    %(status)s = 'All'
    OR t.status = %(status)s
ORDER BY
    t.start_date DESC
